profile_text.body:
Cadence Design Systems is a public company headquartered in San Jose, California, and trades under the ticker CDNS. It is registered with the SEC under CIK 0000813672. On its own website, Cadence describes itself as a leading EDA and Intelligent System Design provider delivering hardware, software, and IP for electronic design. The site also states that Cadence is about being a great company, citing its culture, a Fortune 100 Great Places to Work listing, and its investment in sustainability.

The harvested site text does not name specific products, so no product-level detail is available here. The company's stated position rests on electronic design automation and what it calls Intelligent System Design, spanning hardware, software, and intellectual property for electronic design.

The held record shows no lawsuits and no MCP servers associated with the company. Its recorded law exposure is California, with a count of 282.
